product_one_liner.value: Naïve provides infrastructure for founders and existing businesses to deploy AI employees that build applications, run sales and marketing, and serve customers.

named_customers.notes: Naïve names both in its claim that it is deployed at 500+ companies.

employee_band.notes: The current company and jobs profiles report a team size of 12.

hq_location.notes: Dealroom explicitly lists San Francisco headquarters, consistent with YC's company location. Sources conflict: the August 2026 funding announcement describes Naïve as Palo Alto-based.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index lists only one engineering post, below the required two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes Agent, Session, Events, Computer and Skills articles, plus framework-integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Under the requested title-keyword rule, none of the six current openings qualifies. Agents and RL engineering roles are listed, but their titles contain none of the specified keywords.

model_provider.value: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta and Mistral, through OpenRouter.
model_provider.notes: The documentation describes an OpenRouter wrapper routing to 300+ models, rather than one exclusive model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names none of the five specified certifications or compliance standards; it references infrastructure-provider standards and attestations available upon request.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 6, 2026; led by Nexus Venture Partners.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 Series A falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Neither current job board lists an SDR, BDR or account executive among its six openings. An older account-executive listing is explicitly marked closed.

launched_6mo.notes: On November 2, 2026, Naïve launched its Music primitive, which generates an original song from a description and saves it to Files.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP appointment or departure could be verified. The site's team page describes AI agents, not a human leadership roster with start dates.

crm_stack_signal.notes: An older SDR posting names these as example tools candidates should know; this is a hiring signal, not confirmation that all four are deployed internally.
